info.title: REOS API
info.description: The REOS REST API used by the mobile app and partner integrations. Version 1 lives under `/api/v1`; breaking changes go to a new version (see ADR 0003).

put.description:
Use another role the person holds; this device remembers it, and
signing in again returns to it. Answers 422 with reason
`roles.errors.notHeld` for a role the person doesn't hold. Admin roles
can be chosen without two-step, but `permissions` stays empty and
`two_step.required` is true until it is set up.

get.description: Live, verified providers serving the cities where I work (from my deals and MLS listings in 12 months), near first, with ratings and whether I'm connected; and each category's count.

get.summary: Reviews and my connection with a provider

post.description: Connected at once, with a private chat in Messages. Contacts still need both to press Share. If the provider already asked, this accepts. Never counts toward the provider's monthly limit.
After 30 days connected; one review per agent per provider (a second replaces the first). No contact details in the note.

get.description: Agents I closed with and can rate, and my own feedback: nothing shows until three agents have rated me; then the averages, the comments (no names), and a tip.

post.description: Rates the other side's agent on a closed deal of mine (they must be a REOS agent on the deal's parties), once.

put.description: Shows my average on my public agent page (only with three ratings or more), or hides it.

post.description: Reported ratings leave the average until REOS support looks. Send no reason to take the report back (Undo).

get.description: REOS agents working in the provider's areas (MLS listings and REOS deals in 12 months), by level: new, active or top producer. First name and initial only; never contacts. With this month's requests used and left.
The provider's requests, newest first: waiting, accepted, declined, expired or withdrawn.

post.description: Counts toward the plan's monthly limit (Listed 5, Pro 25, Partner 75). The note can't hold phone numbers, email addresses or links. 422 with `limit` when the month's requests are used.
It still counts toward the month.

get.description:
From each brokerage, school or association I belong to, newest first
(the latest 20), with whether I've read each. New ones arrive live on
`users.{id}` (`announcement.posted`).

post.summary: Mark an announcement read (B6.1b): it counts toward "Read by"

Unread people first, then by name. `can_remind` is false once everyone
has read it, or for a day after the last reminder.

Public values only (Sentry DSN, PostHog project key, the Reverb key), the
same ones a browser receives. `null` means the service is switched off.

post.description: Approve or return (with a note) a post or page; answer a question, optionally adding the answer to the brokerage's knowledge. Returns the queue.

put.description: How many working hours (8 AM to 6 PM Central, Monday to Friday) an item may wait before the office admins are told. The designated broker only.

get.description: The 30 most recent, newest first.

get.description: Screen k10: answers from the course are free; answers beyond it use this month's free credits, then the sponsor's pool, then credits bought on reos.com.

get.description: Whether the assistant may read my CRM, deals and calendar, the starters, and my recent chats.

My own data is read only once I've allowed it; otherwise the answer asks (kind "permission").

put.description: One switch for my CRM contacts, deals and calendar; audited. Turn it off any time.

get.description: Each with rating, languages, topics, prices (cents; 0 is included) and next free hour.
Slots for the next 14 days, 30 and 60 minutes (UTC).
get.summary: One instructor and their free slots

get.description: The instructor's or mentor's offer, or null before they set one, and the most their school allows (cents; null is no limit).

post.description: The student until 24 hours before (refunded) or later (not refunded); the instructor any time (refunded).
Once, after it ends; shown on the instructor's profile after 24 hours.

get.description:
The tools you may see, with what you can do with each. A status change
in the back office shows here at once, with no app release.

Up to its capacity; reminders come an hour and 10 minutes before.

post.summary: Bring a student on, or take them off

Email the link to the client

get.description: Sold (within `months`) and active comparables from the same MLS within `radius` miles, nearest first; each one's price per square foot applied to my listing's size, and the range (25th to 75th percentile) from what sold.
get.summary: A CMA for one of my listings

get.description: Whether it's published, its address, and my short bio.

put.summary: Publish or hide my public page

get.description:
The smart drill (the three weakest topics, how many recent misses it
will bring back, and any drill still open), fix plans under way, and
every practice mode ranked by what helps most, each with why.

In a smart drill, before answering: one wrong option to strike out, a
nudge that never gives the answer. Hints are kept, and cost points only
in challenges.
Texas advertising rules, fair housing wording (with context exceptions and a second opinion for unclear wording) and the brokerage's phrases.
Swaps flagged wording for words about the home, or takes it out.

get.description: Yours, and your active organisation's when your role there manages it.

post.description:
Returns the tool's sign-in address. Open it in a secure browser sheet;
after signing in, the tool comes back to REOS, which returns to
`reos://connections?outcome=connected|cancelled|failed&integration=…`.

Tools connected with the person's own API key (Follow Up Boss) take
`api_key` instead: the key is checked with the tool at once and the
new connection's id comes back (422 when the tool refuses it).
Queues a sync of every stream; the list shows the new time when it's done.

patch.description:
A new history range syncs again from its start; nothing already synced
is lost. Calendars also take which calendars to read (full, busy only
or off) and which one REOS's own events go to (screen 16).

delete.description:
REOS asks the tool to forget its access, then deletes the tokens and
everything it synced from this account.

get.description:
`switches`: each privacy switch, on or off, and whether the person
chose it (otherwise it's the default for their role). `records`: every
consent given or withdrawn, newest first, with the version of the words,
how (`web`, `app`, `admin`, `sms`) and whether it can be withdrawn.
get.summary: My privacy switches and consents (A6.3, Me › Privacy)

put.description:
Switches take `granted` true or false. Consents for one thing (a
session recording, contact sharing with a provider) can only be
withdrawn here, with their `subject`. The terms and privacy notice go
only with the account (422).
put.summary: Change a privacy switch or withdraw a consent (A6.3)

get.description:
Every source in one list, newest change first: by tab (segment), tag
or search, with the last touch and the AI next step while it's fresh,
plus the count in each tab and your tags.

parameters.name: segment
parameters.description: All, new, active, past or sphere.

post.description:
Saved in REOS at once and created in your default CRM (screen 24)
unless it already knows them; matched to people you have on email or
phone. `sent_to` is null when it stays in REOS.

get.description:
What changed in your contacts and where it came from, newest first, and
possible duplicates to merge.

post.description:
Read on the phone, with your permission, in batches of up to 500. They
are matched like any other source and never written back to the phone.

delete.summary: Stop using your phone's contacts: they are removed from REOS unless another source also has them

get.summary:
One contact: every source that knows them, notes (newest first), your
tasks about them, recent sync activity, and the AI insight while it's
fresh (null until you ask for one)

patch.summary: Change the stage; sent to the person's connected CRMs

post.description: Saved at once and sent to every connected CRM that knows this person.

post.summary: Merge another contact into this one. Every source link is kept, and the merge can be split again
Undo a merge: the contact that was merged in comes back on its own
"Not the same person": dismiss a suggested merge

Where new contacts go: each connected CRM, whether it takes new people,
and the default.

put.description: One of your CRMs that takes new people, or null: new contacts stay in REOS.

get.description:
The one contact most in need of a touch (an overdue task first), with
the AI next step and why, or null when there's none.

post.description:
Written from the contact's notes, tasks and activity in every source,
and kept until the contact changes. Free for agents; over the hourly
AI limit you get 429.

A to-do about the person, sent to the CRM that knows them and synced
most recently (`sent_to` is null when it stays in REOS).

You called or texted from your own phone: saved as a note and sent to
every connected CRM that knows the person.

get.description: A week (Sunday to Saturday) or a month of my posts in my time zone: scheduled posts at their time, posts on the day they went out, and drafts planned for a day.

post.summary: Move a post to another day

post.description: A new draft with the same words, media and places, planned for the day.

get.description: Newest first, with what a review costs, my credits left, whether the sample contract is offered, and my deals' documents to choose from.

The review runs in the background (status "reviewing", then "done" or "failed", with a notification); credits are charged only when it's done.
On the deal as key dates (with to-dos), or as to-dos with their days when the review has no deal. Done once.
post.summary: Add the deadlines to my calendar

post.description: The findings and deadlines go to the broker as a virtual broker question, to confirm or correct. Done once.
An answer from the contract's own pages, naming them, and a note for the client. 1 credit.

get.description: Open deals by stage (and closed ones from the last 90 days), each with its next deadline.

Deadlines in the next two weeks, and deals missing documents (phone screen 10).
Connections › Transactions (screen 17): each deal's stage, documents complete, next deadline and commission. Read only.
Parties, documents and key dates.

Net this month, what goes out in the next weekly payout, each sale's
share (newest first) and recent payouts, in cents (USD). Bank and tax
details are managed on Stripe from the web; `account` says whether
payouts are set up (`ready`, `onboarding`, `needsInfo`, or null).
Instructors and mentors only (404 for other roles).

when I have nothing paid or sponsored (the app shows the Membership
screen).

system browser. When the person has signed in, the browser returns to
`reos://auth?code=…`. Send that code with the PKCE verifier. Codes work
once, for two minutes.

post.description: A city or a ZIP code in my MLS, the tag of the contacts who get its update, and my postal address for the emails.

post.description: To my contacts with the area's tag, less anyone who unsubscribed. Refused when the compliance check blocks it, or within a week of the last update.

The whole deck with each card's schedule, for reviewing offline, plus
how many are due and how many new cards are left today. The course's
approved flashcards for lessons started are added first. `topic`
keeps to one topic.

post.description:
From a check-in, an Ask answer, or answer review (with the question,
saved once). The card is due at once.

Again, Hard or Got it (1, 2 or 3) for one card, or the phone's offline
queue. Each review has its own id and counts once; they apply oldest
first. Returns the cards as now scheduled.

get.description:
Ten exam-style questions for the state, in `locale` (en or es), each
with its answer, explanation and source. No account needed.

The free quiz is answered before sign-up and kept on the phone; the
app sends it here straight after the account is created.

Returns the application name, deployed version and server time.
Needs no authentication and never touches the database.

Send the ID token the provider's SDK returned. Creates the account on
first sign-in, or joins an existing account with the same verified
email. Returns a bearer token for this device.

get.description: The live categories with what each checks and asks for, and the flat monthly plan prices (cents) in a state.

Text, a list of values (from the category's options when it has them) or true/false, per field key.

get.description:
Live courses for my current state, with their lessons.

CE and qualifying courses carry `credit` (the approval number and hours)
only with an approval in force in my state; otherwise it's null and the
course isn't labelled CE or qualifying.

For agents (A14.2): CE first when my license renews within 120 days and I still owe hours, then courses for the skills role-play found weakest (or the `topic` asked for, from a fix's lesson link), then for my mode. Each says why and whether I can listen to it (audio-only). Empty for other roles.

switched on, meaning). Each opens at its heading, page or second.

link to the file), the video (Mux `hls` with a signed token, or the
original `file`) and its captions with timings. Links last two hours.
404 unless the lesson is in a live course for my current state; 402
(`membership_required`) when it needs a plan I don't have yet (each
course's first lesson is free).

get.summary: List my licences, live states first

Checks the number with the state's regulator. A match in your name
counts at once (`check: verified`); a different name, a state with no
check yet, or (with `review: true`) a number the regulator doesn't have
goes to a reviewer. Without `review`, an unknown number is refused (422).

Looks the number up with the state's regulator without saving it, so
the person sees the name, type, status and expiry first. Adding it
(`POST /me/licences`) checks again.

Checked with the Texas Real Estate Commission's public license data.

The requirement for the current period comes from the state's rules
in force today (each part names its source), less completed CE. Null
when the state has no CE rules yet.
get.summary: What CE this licence still needs

patch.summary: Set who you supervise (changes your CE)

"Not me": REOS stops suggesting it.
Its listings leave My listings; confirming it again brings them back.

get.description: Every kind of problem with how many the candidate has solved.

New numbers of the kind asked for: the problem and its steps, without
the answers (the server checks each step).

Right: the answer as shown, and whether the problem is solved. Wrong:
the step's hint. `reveal` shows the answer instead. Steps go in order.

Signs out every device now and deletes the account after 30 days;
signing in again before then keeps it. Needs a sign-in from the last
15 minutes: otherwise answers 403 with reason
`identity.errors.recentSignInRequired`, and the app asks the person to
sign in again first.

get.summary: List the devices signed in to this account

delete.description:
Use the current device's id to sign out here, or another id to sign
out a lost or old phone.

post.description: Sends the plans page on reos.com to my email.

at once. 422 when the code is unknown, expired, full or already used.

many are unread; `unread` is the total for the Messages badge. Live
updates arrive on the private Reverb channel `users.{id}`
(`message.posted`). 404 when Messages isn't rolled out to the person.

to 19) a group starts, optionally named. Up to 5 `files[]` (images and

school staff and their students, mentors and mentees.

messages), urgent (arrives in quiet hours) or can be a digest; quiet
hours and the time zone they follow.
